text:
nora-finance: autopay declined for customer NovaClinic (NC-77). Invoice INV-2026-211, $9,840, provider returned `card_declined`.
treasury-bot: [automated] attempt=pay_aa21 status=failed code=issuer_restricted last4=4005 bin=400500 country=US
paul-payments: bin 4005xx often shows issuer blocks for SaaS MCCs when using VPANs. can we try one manual retry?
mike-billing: prefer single retry, but if it fails move to manual invoice + wire/ACH options.
zoe-cs: customer called — AP says they used a travel-card VPAN and can wire today. asking for our wire details and whether we charge a fee.
julia-cfo: OK to accept wire. waive fee for first-time customers; mark policy note.
paul-payments: queued retry attempt=pay_aa21-r1 scheduled=2026-10-20T14:10:00Z
paul-payments: retry failed, provider message: "merchant_category_blocked".
mike-billing: disable autopay for invoice, send manual pay link + wire stanza. zoe, ask them to include INV-2026-211 in reference and send bank trace when done.
zoe-cs: messaging AP with wire stanza and request for trace.
paul-payments: ledger entry LE-99500 created; autopay_hold=true note="VPAN bin 4005xx".
zoe-cs: AP sent bank confirmation with trace W-20261020-NC77. expected clear today.
paul-payments: treasury will watch. when funds clear, post payment and re-enable autopay only after reauthorization.
mike-billing: posted payment at 17:05Z, invoice PAID, no fee applied (waived). sent receipt and re-enabled account note recommending ACH for future.
zoe-cs: customer confirmed account change to ACH for next cycle.
julia-cfo: thanks all — please flag if VPAN declines rise across enterprise customers.
